label: early original-phase accumulator of x/t/c/y/3/v/q/e tokens (positions 1-4)
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase, almost entirely at positions 1-5 (t=2-3 carry ~76% of mass; never at t=0, essentially never on the delimiter or copy phase, never at t>=7). Within that window it behaves like a token-weighted accumulator: it is driven by a particular set of earlier tokens (x, t, c, y, 3, v, q, e as prev/prev2/first token, 2-3.7x lift) plus the current token being x, c, 3, q or l. The strongest activations are on the 2nd-4th tokens of sequences opening with tokens like t/v/e/y followed by x/y/t, e.g. t x x u or v y x x. Mostly fires on the first occurrence of a token (in_first). It fades by position 5-6 even if favored tokens keep arriving. The predicate (step 1-4 and at least two hits from the favored sets) gets about 0.59 precision and 0.65 recall, with ~79% of mass on dev. The real unit is a graded weighted sum, so the boolean threshold misses weak activations and over-fires at the low end.
